task.title: Weekly grocery list built from the plan
task.description:
Owner decisions (2026-11-18):
- Each week's plan creates a list in the app's existing grocery lists (no special live list).
- The list is updated on request and keeps hand edits and ticks.
- Quantities: each cooked recipe scaled to the planner's people count, plus another round for every Leftovers slot that points back at it.
- Merging: the app's existing merging (unit conversion, canonical names).
